entries.title: Joel 1:1
segments: The word of Jehovah that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.

entries.title: Joel 1:2
segments: Hear this, ye old men, and give ear, all ye inhabitants of the land. Hath this been in your days, or in the days of your fathers?

entries.title: Joel 1:3
segments: Tell ye your children of it, and [let] your children [tell] their children, and their children another generation.

entries.title: Joel 1:4
segments: That which the palmer-worm hath left hath the locust eaten; and that which the locust hath left hath the canker-worm eaten; and that which the canker-worm hath left hath the caterpillar eaten.

entries.title: Joel 1:5
segments: Awake, ye drunkards, and weep; and wail, all ye drinkers of wine, because of the sweet wine; for it is cut off from your mouth.

entries.title: Joel 1:6
segments: For a nation is come up upon my land, strong, and without number; his teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he hath the jaw-teeth of a lioness.

entries.title: Joel 1:7
segments: He hath laid my vine waste, and barked my fig-tree: he hath made it clean bare, and cast it away; the branches thereof are made white.

entries.title: Joel 1:8
segments: Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth for the husband of her youth.

entries.title: Joel 1:9
segments: The meal-offering and the drink-offering are cut off from the house of Jehovah; the priests, Jehovah's ministers, mourn.

entries.title: Joel 1:10
segments: The field is laid waste, the land mourneth; for the grain is destroyed, the new wine is dried up, the oil languisheth.

entries.title: Joel 1:11
segments: Be confounded, O ye husbandmen, wail, O ye vinedressers, for the wheat and for the barley; for the harvest of the field is perished.

entries.title: Joel 1:12
segments: The vine is withered, and the fig-tree languisheth; the pomegranate-tree, the palm-tree also, and the apple-tree, even all the trees of the field are withered: for joy is withered away from the sons of men.

entries.title: Joel 1:13
segments: Gird yourselves [with sackcloth], and lament, ye priests; wail, ye ministers of the altar; come, lie all night in sackcloth, ye ministers of my God: for the meal-offering and the drink-offering are withholden from the house of your God.

entries.title: Joel 1:14
segments: Sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly, gather the old men [and] all the inhabitants of the land unto the house of Jehovah your God, and cry unto Jehovah.

entries.title: Joel 1:15
segments: Alas for the day! for the day of Jehovah is at hand, and as destruction from the Almighty shall it come.

entries.title: Joel 1:16
segments: Is not the food cut off before our eyes, [yea], joy and gladness from the house of our God?

entries.title: Joel 1:17
segments: The seeds rot under their clods; the garners are laid desolate, the barns are broken down; for the grain is withered.

entries.title: Joel 1:18
segments: How do the beasts groan! the herds of cattle are perplexed, because they have no pasture; yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.

entries.title: Joel 1:19
segments: O Jehovah, to thee do I cry; for the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame hath burned all the trees of the field.

entries.title: Joel 1:20
segments: Yea, the beasts of the field pant unto thee; for the water brooks are dried up, and the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
